text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today was a visit to watch the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup! Emerging victorious from 
the breathtaking, white-knuckle battle was 
the witch-girl Umamusume, Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to the crowd, this is a 
prestigious battle. Winning here means... 
in other words, that I shall become a 
princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
someday too! Once that's decided, there's 
nothing left but special training! 
Princess☆Axe Kick! Deryaaa~~!
